summary: Lodging Fund REIT III, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that its Board of Directors' Special Committee, composed solely of independent directors, has retained Piper Sandler & Co. as financial advisor and Faegre Drinker Biddle & Reath LLP as legal counsel to explore a range of strategic alternatives to maximize shareholder value. Alternatives include a sale or merger, stock exchange listing, asset sale, recapitalization, or continuation of the current business plan. No specific transaction has been approved, and no timetable for completion has been set. This is a formal strategic review process with no premium or price terms stated. Watch for potential sale or listing announcement; no actionable deal terms yet.
